email.body1:
Jack, saw Onspring rolled out Onspring AI for the GRC platform and is hiring out sales development.

Adding AI to the product plus growing the team usually means more in-market GRC and IRM accounts than reps can cover before new hires ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Onspring off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Jack, quick follow-up for Onspring.

While you ramp new SDRs, pipeline targets rarely wait. Most teams cannot tell how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Onspring needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jack, last bit of proof for Onspring.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Onspring's reply rate likely compares to other GRC software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
